title: 12% of Remote Listings Now Require AI Skills – What It Means for Your Career
description: AI is listed in 12% of active remote jobs (487 listings). See which roles need AI, how pay stacks up, and whether you should double‑down on AI expertise.
text:
**TL;DR** - **AI demand:** 487 of 3,928 remote listings (12%) explicitly require AI skills. - **Top pay:** Jabil offers **USD 132,400–238,400** per year for a Sr. Principal Product Engineer – a role that lists AI‑adjacent cloud expertise. - **Company spread:** AI requirements appear at Jabil, Sardine, Sycle LLC, Creator, HSS Careers, Censys, and Devoted Studios. - **Contrarian note:** Not every AI‑titled job pays premium; many still hide pay (78% of listings give no salary). - **CTA:** Search “AI” on  [Loker Dollar](https://lokerdollar.com/en/jobs) to filter remote roles that list AI skills. 1427 open Engineering roles · 276 posted this week - [Lead Software Engineer (Graphics)Cadence](https://lokerdollar.com/en/jobs/lead-software-engineer-graphics-cadence--job_themuse_22263925?origin_surface=blog&content_slug=ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026) - [Staff Software Engineer - Java BackendEquinix, Inc](https://lokerdollar.com/en/jobs/staff-software-engineer-java-backend-equinix-inc--job_themuse_22204848?origin_surface=blog&content_slug=ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026) - [SAP Basis Senior SME - RISE with SAP (MSM)Kyndryl](https://lokerdollar.com/en/jobs/sap-basis-senior-sme-rise-with-sap-msm-kyndryl--job_themuse_22186102?origin_surface=blog&content_slug=ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026) [See all Engineering jobs](https://lokerdollar.com/en/remote-jobs/engineering) ## What proportion of remote listings now list AI as a required skill? Our latest snapshot (2026‑10‑12) shows **487** remote jobs mentioning AI out of **3,928** analyzed listings, which translates to a **12%** share. ## Which remote roles are most likely to list AI requirements? AI shows up across a surprisingly wide set of titles: - **Senior Software Engineer – Healthcare / SaaS** (Sycle LLC) – AI‑enhanced diagnostics. - **Sr. Principal Product Engineer – Cloud & Hyperscale** (Jabil) – AI workloads on massive infrastructure. - **People Ops Partner** (Sardine) – AI‑driven talent analytics (salary quoted in CAD). - **Business Development Representative** (Creator) – AI‑enabled SaaS sales pitches. - **Insurance Agent** (HSS Careers) – AI‑assisted risk assessment (pay undisclosed). Even non‑technical roles like **Live Ops Manager** at Devoted Studios list AI as a “nice‑to‑have” for automation. ## How does AI skill demand compare with other hot skills? | Skill | Listings requiring it | Share of analysed listings | | --- | --- | --- | | AI | 487 | **12%** | | Communication | 1,592 | **41%** | | Leadership | 413 | **11%** | | Sales | 356 | **9%** | | Project Management | 305 | **8%** | | Data Analysis | 267 | **7%** | AI sits behind communication but ahead of leadership and sales in pure frequency, underscoring its growing relevance. ## What compensation signals are we seeing for AI‑related remote roles? Only **22%** of all active remote listings disclose pay (844 of 3,919). Among those that do, the highest disclosed range is the **USD 132,400–238,400** yearly bracket at Jabil. Other listings: - **People Ops Partner – Sardine:** CAD 120,000–150,000 per year (not USD). - **Senior Software Engineer – Sycle LLC:** CAD 120,000–140,000 per year. - **Senior BDR – Creator:** CAD 62,000–75,000 per year. The majority (78%) hide salary, so you’ll often need to negotiate based on market data rather than posted figures. ## Should you double‑down on AI skills if you’re already strong in your core discipline? **Contrarian take:** While AI is a differentiator, the premium isn’t guaranteed. Companies still prioritize communication (41% of listings) and domain expertise. ## How can you showcase AI expertise in a remote application? 1. **Add a dedicated “AI Skills” section** on your resume (list frameworks, libraries, and projects). 2. **Link to a public repo or demo** (GitHub, Hugging Face). 3. **Mention AI in your cover letter** with concrete outcomes relevant to the role. 4. **Highlight cross‑functional AI work** (e.g., AI‑driven product decisions for non‑technical teams). ## What does the broader market say about AI‑focused services? Industry analysts note the surge in AI‑driven cloud services. EY was named a **Leader in IDC MarketScape for WW Cloud Professional Services in the AI Era 2026**【 [https://www.ey.com/en\_gl/newsroom/2026/10/ey-named-a-leader-in-idc-marketscape-for-ww-cloud-professional-services-in-the-ai-era-2026】](https://www.ey.com/en_gl/newsroom/2026/10/ey-named-a-leader-in-idc-marketscape-for-ww-cloud-professional-services-in-the-ai-era-2026%E3%80%91), reinforcing that enterprises are investing heavily in AI capabilities. ## Methodology - **Data source:** Loker Dollar remote‑job listings database (D1 jobs table). - **Query date:** 2026‑10‑13. - **Sample size:** 3,919 active listings; 3,928 listings used for skill‑demand snapshot. - **Limitations:** Only listings present on the platform are captured; pay figures are self‑reported by employers; “AI” keyword may miss jobs that require AI without naming it. ## What we don’t know - **Geographic salary differentials:** We lack breakdowns by country or region. - **Skill depth:** Whether “AI” refers to basic prompt engineering or advanced deep‑learning research is unclear. - **Hiring velocity:** Time‑to‑fill for AI‑required roles isn’t tracked in the current dataset. ## FAQ ### Which remote roles most often list AI as a requirement? Roles ranging from senior engineering (e.g., Jabil’s Sr. Principal Product Engineer) to people operations (Sardine) and sales (Creator) now frequently mention AI. ### Does a disclosed salary guarantee a higher pay than undisclosed listings? Not necessarily. Only **22%** of listings disclose pay, and the disclosed ranges vary widely. Many high‑pay roles still hide salary, so you’ll need to negotiate based on market benchmarks. ### How can I quickly verify if a remote job truly needs AI expertise? Search the job description for specific AI terms (e.g., “machine learning,” “TensorFlow,” “prompt engineering”). If only “AI‑savvy” is mentioned, treat it as a soft requirement and be prepared to demonstrate concrete experience.
